# TPC-DS-OBT Q10

```{tags} reference, query-template, tpcds_obt
```

> [TPC-DS-OBT](../../tpc-ds-obt.md) benchmark · [all TPC-DS-OBT queries](index.md)

## Representative SQL

Rendered for **DataFusion** with default parameters.

```sql
SELECT
  bill_cdemo_cd_gender,
  bill_cdemo_cd_marital_status,
  bill_cdemo_cd_education_status,
  COUNT(*) AS cnt1,
  bill_cdemo_cd_purchase_estimate,
  COUNT(*) AS cnt2,
  bill_cdemo_cd_credit_rating,
  COUNT(*) AS cnt3,
  bill_cdemo_cd_dep_count,
  COUNT(*) AS cnt4,
  bill_cdemo_cd_dep_employed_count,
  COUNT(*) AS cnt5,
  bill_cdemo_cd_dep_college_count,
  COUNT(*) AS cnt6
FROM tpcds_sales_returns_obt AS obt
WHERE
  (
    ship_customer_c_current_addr_sk = bill_addr_ca_address_sk
    AND bill_addr_ca_county IN ('2', '2', '2', '2', '2')
    AND bill_cdemo_cd_demo_sk = ship_customer_c_current_cdemo_sk
    AND EXISTS(
      SELECT
        *
      FROM tpcds_sales_returns_obt AS obt
      WHERE
        (
          obt.ship_customer_c_customer_sk = obt.ship_customer_sk
          AND obt.sold_date_sk = obt.sold_date_d_date_sk
          AND obt.sold_date_d_year = 1999
          AND obt.sold_date_d_moy BETWEEN 1 AND 1 + 3
        )
        AND channel = 'store'
    )
    AND (
      EXISTS(
        SELECT
          *
        FROM tpcds_sales_returns_obt AS obt
        WHERE
          (
            obt.ship_customer_c_customer_sk = obt.bill_customer_sk
            AND obt.sold_date_sk = obt.sold_date_d_date_sk
            AND obt.sold_date_d_year = 1999
            AND obt.sold_date_d_moy BETWEEN 1 AND 1 + 3
          )
          AND channel = 'web'
      )
      OR EXISTS(
        SELECT
          *
        FROM tpcds_sales_returns_obt AS obt
        WHERE
          (
            obt.ship_customer_c_customer_sk = obt.ship_customer_sk
            AND obt.sold_date_sk = obt.sold_date_d_date_sk
            AND obt.sold_date_d_year = 1999
            AND obt.sold_date_d_moy BETWEEN 1 AND 1 + 3
          )
          AND channel = 'catalog'
      )
    )
  )
  AND channel IN ('catalog', 'store', 'web')
GROUP BY
  bill_cdemo_cd_gender,
  bill_cdemo_cd_marital_status,
  bill_cdemo_cd_education_status,
  bill_cdemo_cd_purchase_estimate,
  bill_cdemo_cd_credit_rating,
  bill_cdemo_cd_dep_count,
  bill_cdemo_cd_dep_employed_count,
  bill_cdemo_cd_dep_college_count
ORDER BY
  bill_cdemo_cd_gender,
  bill_cdemo_cd_marital_status,
  bill_cdemo_cd_education_status,
  bill_cdemo_cd_purchase_estimate,
  bill_cdemo_cd_credit_rating,
  bill_cdemo_cd_dep_count,
  bill_cdemo_cd_dep_employed_count,
  bill_cdemo_cd_dep_college_count
LIMIT 100
```
